title: Representation-tame Geiß-Leclerc-Schröer algebras and a revised GLS conjecture on root systems
summary: Using Galois covering theory and equivariant techniques, we classify all connected representation-tame Geiß--Leclerc--Schröer (GLS) algebras in terms of their defining triples $(C,D,Ω)$. We then study the GLS algebras $H(\widetilde{CD}_n)$ with minimal symmetrizers, where $n\geq 2$ and $\widetilde{CD}_2=\widetilde{B}_2$.
